net sales.text: Revenue: We primarily derive our on-going revenues from technology-enabled business solutions, reported in our Healthcare IT segment, which typically includes revenue cycle management and is billed as a percentage of payments collected by our customers. This fee includes the ability to use our EHR, practice management systems and other software as part of the bundled fee. These solutions accounted for approximately 63% and 67% of our revenues during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. This includes customers utilizing our proprietary product suites, as well as customers from acquisitions of RCM companies which we are servicing utilizing third-party software. Key drivers of our revenue include growth in the number of providers we are servicing, the number of patients served by those providers, and collections by those providers.
